chapter_name: Mediums and Techniques in Visual Art
learning_objective: 🖌️ Explore the artist's toolbox! Discover the different materials (mediums) and physical techniques used to create 2D and 3D masterpieces.

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: माध्यम (वह सामग्री जिससे कलाकृति बनाई जाती है, जैसे तेल रंग, मिट्टी या चारकोल)
फ्रेस्को / भित्ति चित्र (गीले प्लास्टर पर रंग लगाकर दीवार पर चित्र बनाना)
छापाकला (एक सांचे से कागज पर कई चित्र छापने की तकनीक)
मूर्तिकला (पत्थर, धातु या मिट्टी से 3D रूप बनाना)
मिश्रित माध्यम (एक ही कलाकृति में कई अलग-अलग सामग्रियों का उपयोग करना)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: These are materials that do not use water or solvents. Examples include graphite (pencils), charcoal (creates deep blacks, easily smudged), soft pastels, and crayons. They are perfect for sketching and shading.

Watercolors are transparent and require water. Oil paints take a long time to dry but offer rich, blendable colors. Acrylics are modern plastic-based paints that dry fast and are water-resistant when dry.

Sculptors work in three dimensions. They use techniques like Carving (subtracting material from stone or wood), Modeling (shaping soft clay), and Casting (pouring melted metal like bronze into a mold).

Instead of drawing one unique piece, artists carve an image into wood, linoleum, or metal, apply ink, and press it onto paper. This allows them to create multiple copies (editions) of the exact same artwork.

Today, artists use drawing tablets and software (Digital Art) to paint with pixels. 'Mixed Media' involves combining totally different materials—like gluing newspaper, painting over it with acrylics, and drawing with ink (Collage).

fun_activity.title: ✂️ Make a Mixed Media Collage
fun_activity.instructions: Find old magazines, newspapers, or colored wrappers. Cut out interesting shapes, words, or faces. Glue them onto a blank page to create a new picture. Finally, use a pen or marker to draw outlines and details over the glued pieces!

exam_tips: 📌 Distinguish between Additive sculpture (modeling clay, adding material) and Subtractive sculpture (carving stone/wood, taking material away).
📌 Know the difference between Oil paint (slow drying, uses oil as a binder) and Acrylic paint (fast drying, uses acrylic polymer as a binder).
📌 'Fresco' is highly durable because the paint literally becomes part of the wall as the wet plaster dries.
quick_recap: ⭐ The plural of medium is 'mediums' (in art) or 'media'.
⭐ Printmaking techniques include Woodcut, Etching, and Lithography.
⭐ Charcoal is one of the oldest art mediums in the world, dating back to prehistoric cave paintings.
